text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while walking through the academy—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: You want me to give this letter to Pokke-chan?

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"I figured since Dantsu is in your class, maybe you could...
I just... couldn't bring myself to hand it over in person..."

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
If possible, I'd like you to keep it a secret that it's from me.
Um... it's kind of embarrassing.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ! Of course, leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Um, you see,
there's something I want to give to Pokke-chan.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Huh, a letter? Who's it from?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I-I can't tell you that~
But—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I think it's truly wonderful to express your feelings through a letter in this day and age.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
So since you went through the trouble...
I hope you'll cherish it.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Got it, got it. Thanks, man.
I'll read it later.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even after that—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Dantsu-san... Do you know where Uni-san is?
I have something I want to give her,
but she wasn't in the classroom.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Everyone in class looked so busy,
so, um... I couldn't bring myself to speak up.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Universe-chan?
Ah, maybe she's up on the rooftop.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I saw them a while back
when I was helping clean the rooftop~.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"‘Communion’... ‘Analysis’...
‘Luminous Universe’... ‘BRGT’..."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"...Dantsu Flame.
Do you... like space, too?"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Neo Universe... Dantsu Flame...
Are they not... 'isotopes'...?"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Um, um...! 
Of course I love it! Outer space!
The stars are so pretty, and, um... it's awesome!"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"...Link, 'observing'.
Will you... 'communicate'... too?"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: "I was thinking of heading there today too, but—oh, that's it... Rob Roy-chan, why don't you come with me!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! But...
Is it really okay to just drop by unannounced?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, of course!
Plus, you have a present for me, right?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. I found a book that Uni-san might like.
It's a story set in space.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Waah~! All the more reason we have to go, then!
Besides, once Rob Roy-chan gets here—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Universe-chan will definitely, totally love it!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
! ...Yes!
In that case, please let me join you!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: All right, now that that's settled, dash to the rooftop! Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Dantsu-san.
For letting me consult with you so much about class.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
No! Feel free to consult with me anytime.
I'll do anything within my power to help.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
Please let me rely on you again sometime. Well then!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Today was a day where I saw Dants Flame
helping people left and right."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Mmm... whew~
choice_data_list: So you were the one she was confiding in, huh.
So you were the one she was confiding in, I see.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe.
I hope I was able to be of good help.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dantsu Flame let out a sigh.
It was wonderful how she worked so hard for others, but—
at times, I couldn't help but worry about her overly kind nature.
choice_data_list: Make sure you don't push yourself too hard, alright?
Be careful not to push yourself too hard, okay?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Pushing myself? ...Ah!
I'm sorry for worrying you.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"...Still,
I might not look it, but I'm super excited!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Being relied on by someone, answering their expectations,
and seeing them happy... That's what brings me joy.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
So—it's not impossible or unreasonable at all.
I'm doing this because I truly want to!
choice_data_list: Make sure to relax your shoulders every now and then.
Make sure to relax your shoulders every now and then.
Dantsu's such a good girl, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
So—it's not impossible or unreasonable at all.
I'm doing this because I truly want to!
choice_data_list: Make sure to relax your shoulders every now and then.
Make sure to relax your shoulders every now and then.
Dantsu's such a good girl, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much.
Fufu, you worry too much, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I'm fine, really. Because――

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Whenever things truly feel overwhelming,
I'll be sure to rely on you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Huh! Th-That's not true at all.
I'm just doing what comes naturally!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's only natural.
That is why—
choice_data_list: The fact that it's "second nature" to you is what's amazing.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ! Y-You're praising me way too much~... jeez.
